data.name: Baudilio
data.gender_notes: Baudilio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'baudus' meaning 'venerated', and 'ilio' meaning 'bearer'. It refers to a person who is revered and respected. The name Baudilio carries the meaning “Venerated bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Baudilio usually hope their child will grow to embody venerated bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion and reverence towards God.
data.etymology: Baudilio belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Venerated bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baudilio total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
